last_updated: 2026-06-04 (E029 promoted: LLM-router mixed routing GOLD $5.07 — 68% cheaper than sonnet-all)

default_routing.rationale: E029 promoted from agentic LLM router run. LLM router on nomad2018 picked mixed designer+coder=sonnet, rest=haiku and produced GOLD at $5.07 — 68% cheaper than the prior sonnet-all (gold $16, E003). The agent's reasoning: designer plans + coder writes train.py are quality-critical; the other 7 roles evaluate/select/judge rather than generate code, so haiku is sufficient. Splitter bumped from haiku→sonnet to stabilize against the rare haiku-splitter validation failure observed in E033.

fallback_routing.rationale: Pre-E029 default. Use when the mixed routing produces an invalid sub or fails verification.

cost_floor_option.when_to_use: User explicitly accepts a 1-tier medal drop (gold→silver) for an 8-15× cost cut. Single data point — confidence medium because 5 of 6 haiku candidates landed in silver range, showing consistency.

open_questions: Confirm haiku silver on nomad2018 with a second run (E007 is currently n=1).
We have only ONE task in this family. Need more tabular tasks before generalizing the haiku-silver pattern — e.g. nyc-taxi-fare or playground-series-s6e2.
